summaries.en: The Daegu mayoral election has been set as a one-on-one contest between former Prime Minister Kim Boo-kyum of the Democratic Party and former Deputy Prime Minister Choo Kyung-ho, who has been confirmed as the People Power Party's candidate, with Choo emphasizing his economic background to consolidate conservative votes.
summaries.zh: 大邱市长选举已确定为民主党前总理金富谦与国民力量党已获提名的前副总理秋庆鎬之间的一对一对决，秋庆鎬正突出其经济履历以凝聚保守派选票。
